verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
We fall down, we lay our crowns
At the feet of Jesus
The greatness of His mercy and love
At the feet of Jesus

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
We cry holy, holy, holy
We cry holy, holy, holy
We cry holy, holy, holy
Is the Lamb

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
We cry worthy, worthy, worthy
We cry worthy, worthy, worthy
We cry worthy, worthy, worthy
Is the Lamb

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
You are worthy, worthy, worthy
You are worthy, worthy, worthy
You are worthy, worthy, worthy
Is the Lamb

verse.name: v1d
verse.lines:
You shall be holy as I am holy
You shall be holy as I am holy
You shall be holy as I am holy
You shall be holy holy holy

verse.name: v1e
verse.lines:
Who may ascend the hill of the Lord
The one who has clean hands and a pure heart

verse.name: v1f
verse.lines:
I hear songs they're going forth
I hear holy is the Lord

verse.name: v1g
verse.lines: Is not My word like a refiner's fire

verse.name: v1i
verse.lines:
You shall be holy as I am holy
You shall be holy as I am holy, holy, holy
